greebles.task: context-sensitive service panels and industrial surface detail around a biomechanical research bay

pipework.task: a connected service-pipe spine with branches and endpoints following terraced subterranean clearances

architecture.task: an assembly hangar with a legible structural frame, side galleries and a clear central floor route

matched_design: Within a seed row: identical source, region, footprint, materials, primitive contract and maximum native candidate-cell budget. Prompt variant changes only prompt content. Each tile executes independently. Controls generate exactly the same operations across P0-P3 for a given seed; they test the execution pipeline, not prompt quality.
random_control: Relocates the same rectangular components inside the same footprint with a deterministic host seed. Component sizes/count and maximum native budget are unchanged. Overlap and connectivity may differ; all negative outcomes remain in the denominator.
reference_delivery: inspected text card plus immutable original-image link; no image bytes sent by this version
model_comparison_status: pending genuine available and explicitly authorized inference; deterministic and transport-fixture results are not model performance
heldout_policy: Reserved structural groups are not exposed by the development example picker, used for template tuning or represented as completed validation. A separate reviewer/owner must execute the held-out cohort after a prompt revision is frozen.
human_evaluation: Blinded exports conceal provider, model, prompt variant and seed until votes are committed. Judge recognizability, route usefulness, coherent structure and purposeful detail; automated occupancy and connectivity are diagnostics, not an aesthetic score.
